newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Mountain Lakes, N.J..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Borough of Mountain Lakes,
(County of Morris)
New Jersey
General Improvement Bonds
(Book-Entry Bonds) (Bank Qualified) (Callable)

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the BOROUGH OF MOUNTAIN LAKES, in the County of Morris, New Jersey at the Borough of Mountain Lakes, 400 Boulevard, Mountain Lakes, New Jersey on
Wednesday, July 16, 1997,
until 11:00 a.m., for the purchase of the above Bonds of the Borough due July 15 as follows:
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one bond for the aggregate principal amount maturing in each year. The Borough will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Lowenstein, Sandler, Kohl, Fisher & Boylan.
The Bonds will bear interest at a rate of interest in a
multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on January 15, 1998, and

semiannually thereafter on the fifteenth day of January and July in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds are subject to redemption at the option of the
Borough in accordance with the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds are subject to the requirements of SEC Rule 15c2-12 with respect to Secondary Market Disclosure.

The Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting the Chief Financial Officer at the Borough of Mountain Lakes, 400 Boulevard, Mountain Lakes, New Jersey 07046, (201) 334-3131.
DONNA M. MOLLINEAUX
Chief Financial Officer
(From The Bond Buyer)
